channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Blizzard warning issued for northwest Minn. as colder temperatures return to Twin Cities
item.description: Wind gusts up to 70 mph are expected in the Red River Valley.

item.title: Michele Tafoya inches closer to bid for U.S. Senate
item.description: Tafoya has been more vocal on social media in recent weeks, speaking out about fraud and bashing a number of Minnesota Democrats.

item.title: Gophers could be thin on receiving options for Rate Bowl against New Mexico
item.description: Amid departures and a possible opt-out, Minnesota’s wide receiver group likely won’t be at full strength for its Dec. 26 matchup against the Lobos.

item.title: Trump gives a partisan prime-time address insisting the economy is stronger than many voters feel
item.description: President Donald Trump delivered a politically charged speech Wednesday carried live in prime time on network television, seeking to pin the blame for economic challenges on Democrats while announcing he is sending a $1,776 bonus check to U.S. troops for Christmas.

item.title: Old National claims rival Bell Bank staged ‘coup d’etat’ at its Brainerd branch
item.description: Old National sues Bell and eight former Old National workers in Brainerd and Baxter after Bell hired them earlier this month.

item.title: Man accused of stalking Minneapolis council member Koski has decade-long record of harassment
item.description: Emily Koski and her successor-elect, Jamison Whiting, have sought protection in court. Other officials have similar stories.

item.title: Trump again targets Minnesota Somalis in speech; Ilhan Omar seeks ICE records
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security has stepped up immigration enforcement in Minnesota. Arrests and other confrontations have been popping up in more locations.

item.title: From diamonds to hockey, a look at the Twins’ new minority owners
item.description: The sale of part of the team will allow the Pohlad family to pay off “a significant amount” of the organization’s $500 million debt.

item.title: Menards settles false advertising claims over 11% rebate program
item.description: Shoppers will now have a year to submit those rebate forms.

item.title: Stewartville holds vigil for the families of a gunman and his victim
item.description: Residents are embracing the families of a 19-year-old gunman and the high school wrestler he shot Friday.
